#### Measured Tab

The Measured tab shows data that was calculated based on the meter or location’s measured conditions.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 520;height: 285;" />

The following items are available on this tab:

- **Effective Date** - This is the date for which the data is applicable.  This is dependent on contract day, contract hour and resolution.  For hourly resolution, the effective date will be the day and hour the data is effective for.  For daily resolution, the effective date will be at the contract hour for the given day.  For monthly resolution, the effective date will be at the contract day and hour for the given month.
- **Activity Code** - This column will display whether or not any of the activity codes enabled under [System Rollup Configuration](../../Settings%20Manager/System/Rollup%20Configuration.md) are present for the device for a given period. The column will be highlighted an amber color if it is populated by anything and the code associated with the activity record(s) will appear. Right-clicking on a row will display the code and the associated trigger at the bottom of the context menu.
- **Volume** - This is the total volume including PPAs for the meter or location for the stated time span.
- **Energy** - This is the energy reported by the meter for the stated time span.
- **Mass** - This is the mass reported by the meter for the stated time span.
- **Extension or Raw Volume** - The Extension is reported for AGA-3 meters. Raw Volume is reported for AGA-7 meters.
- **Flow Time** - This is the time (hours, min, sec) where there was flow for the stated time span.
- **Differential Pressure or Pulses** - Differential Pressure is displayed for AGA-3 meters, while Total Pulses or Frequency are shown for AGA-7 meters.
- **Pressure** - This is the average static pressure for the meter or location at the given time.
- **Temperature** - This is the average flowing temperature for a meter or location at the given time.
- **Completion Status** - Indicates whether or not there is missing data. If there is no missing data for the time span, the completion status will be complete; otherwise, the completion status will be incomplete.
- **GMS Date** - This is the date that data was written to the database.
- **Projected Volume, Projected Energy, Projected Mass** - For users with Gas Day Projection module. These columns will display the projected values for each data point for the selected meter or location based on the settings defined for Gas Day Projection within the Meter Editor.
